messages.subject: Reference genetic map
parts:
Hi there,
I want to use R/qtl to perform linkage analysis of a mouse bakcross. I have the SNP genotyping data and I want to compare the estimated genetic map from my data to the reference genetic map. In past experiments I converted the SNP positions in base pairs to centiMorgan using the mouse map converter: http://cgd.jax.org/mousemapconverter/
But it seems that the server is not working. I have been looking for other tools to do this, but I did not find any. Any information about this topic would be really helpful.

Kind regards

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Reference genetic map
parts:
I asked folks at the Jackson Lab, who provide the mouse map converter tool. They're working to bring it back; it will be a few days before they can do so.

karl
